CANONICAL_NAME.value: gzip 1.2.4 (1993) -- GNU zip: DEFLATE (LZ77 + Huffman), the redesign forced by the LZW patent

value.lineage: Compression lineage, the HISTORICAL REDESIGN under legal pressure: Unisys's enforcement of the LZW patent (1993-94) made compress unshippable for GNU; Jean-loup Gailly's gzip (1992-93) used Ziv-Lempel 1977 plus Huffman -- DEFLATE, later RFC 1951 and zlib's core -- and replaced compress across Unix. 1.2.4 (Aug 1993) is the version that stayed frozen for a decade. Beside the vault's zlib-1.3.1 (the library form, 2024) and compress/ncompress, this closes the compress -> gzip -> zlib series.

value.built_to: compress files better than compress without infringing the LZW patent, and interoperate forever via a fixed format
value.pressure: the Unisys LZW patent (legal), disk/bandwidth scarcity, portability across 1993 Unixes and DOS
value.success_means: exact round trip, better ratio than compress, patent-free

value.failure_condition: a format change would orphan every archive; a patent claim would stop distribution
